note: Military worn-equipment masses (uniform, garment, vest, rucksack, helmet, webbing, footwear) gathered from published sources. Tier 2 is the US Army ECWCS operator manual TM 10-8415-236-10. Tier 3 is Wikipedia, which quotes the issuing specification for several items (Gentex TP0271 and PEO Soldier for the ACH, PEO Soldier for the IHPS). Tier 4 is manufacturer and brand product material (Ops-Core figures quoted on the Agilite product page, Agilite, Ferro Concepts, Kifaru, Eberlestock, Savotta, Varusteleka, HAIX). Every rucksack row is the EMPTY mass and says so in state. Vest and helmet rows name the configuration in state and never mix a bare carrier with a plated one. No value is estimated, averaged or taken from a mod or engine config. Families reuse the tokens in docs/wiki/research/equipment-library.md where the item appears there. Sources that blocked or published no mass are recorded in leads.
